gloss: Rise to practice at the sound of a rooster crowing; symbolizes diligence and seizing opportunities.
teaser: Ever wondered how a rooster can inspire greatness? Let's find out!
script: Welcome to Chengyu Bites — your quick summary on Chinese 成语. Ever wondered how a rooster can inspire greatness? Let's find out! [break 1s] The phrase is: 闻鸡起舞, wén jī qǐ wǔ. [break 0.5s] 闻 (wén) - to hear; [break 0.5s] 鸡 (jī) - chicken or rooster; [break 0.5s] 起 (qǐ) - to rise or get up; [break 0.5s] 舞 (wǔ) - to dance. [break 1s] The full idiom is 闻鸡起舞, which literally means 'to rise and dance upon hearing a rooster,' and figuratively represents the idea of seizing opportunities and being diligent. [break 1s] Here’s the story behind it: [break 1.5s] This idiom originates from the story of a famous general, Yue Fei, who was so dedicated to his martial arts training that he would wake up at the sound of a rooster to practice. His commitment to self-improvement and seizing the moment became legendary. [break 1.5s] Example one: 他每天都闻鸡起舞，努力学习。 [break 1s] He practices hard every day, rising at the sound of the rooster. [break 1s] Example two: 她闻鸡起舞，早起锻炼。 [break 1s] She rises to work out early at the sound of the rooster. [break 1s] Example three: 我们应该闻鸡起舞，把握每一个机会。 [break 1s] We should seize every opportunity, rising to the occasion like the rooster. [break 1s] So, 闻鸡起舞 means to rise to practice at the sound of a rooster, symbolizing diligence and seizing opportunities. Thank you for listening to Chengyu Bites! See you next time for another idiom. [break 1s]
